learning_outcomes.text: Learning the basics of random processes
Learning to compute average, autocorrelation and cross correlation
Learning to compute power spectral density
Learning the properties of the power spectral density
Learning the transmission of random processes through linear systems
Learning the basics of error detecting and correcting codes.

syllabus_topics: Autocorrelation function. Classification of random processes: Wide sense stationary processes, ergodic processes.
The power spectral density of a random process. Wiener-Khinchine relation. The power of a random process.
Multiple random processes. Uncorrelated, orthogonal and independent processes. Cross power spectral density.
Transmission of random processes through linear systems.
Bandpass random processes. Nonuniqueness of the quadrature representation.
Bandpass white gaussian random process. The sinusoidal signal in noise. Optimum filtering.
Optimum threshold detection. Suboptimum filters. Optimum binary receiver.
M-ary communication: Multiamplitude signaling, multiphase signaling
M-ary communication: Quadrature amplitude modulation, multitone signaling.
Definition of information and entropy. Measure of information entropy of a source. Source encoding.
Error correcting codes: Linear block codes, cyclic codes.
bibliography: Communication Systems, S. Haykin, John Wiley & Sons, 2001, Fourth Edition.
Modern Digital and Analog Communication Systems, B. P. Lathi, Oxford University Press, 1995, Second Edition.
Communication Systems Engineering, J. G. Proakis, M. Salehi, Prentice Hall, 2002, Second Edition.
